Evidence on link’s segments

Place site visits on link’s segments with every species’ access and habitat flags; read a species’ segments, flow, width, regulated reaches, natural barriers downstream and the walks to rivers; count where link’s two access columns disagree; carry each segment’s minimal-network parent; and check that a database-bound run is on the database’s host.

knw_link_place()
Place site visits on link's segments, with access and habitat for every species
knw_parent_join()
Carry each visit's minimal-network parent onto its full-network segment
knw_parent_read()
Read link's parent table, held to the two builds it joins
knw_link_segments()
link's segments for one species in a set of groups, with flow and access, for grading
knw_link_flow()
wet's annual flow on FWA segments, with a parent fallback
knw_link_width()
The channel width link reads on a stream nobody measured, and the waterbody tests
knw_link_regulated()
Points on the FWA network downstream of a regulating dam
knw_link_barrier_dnstr()
Whether a natural barrier to a species lies downstream of each point
knw_link_walks()
Network distance downstream to the first river of each size, on each flow source
knw_walk_md5()
The walk's code, by its md5
knw_discharge_load()
The flow load the database serves, by its table comment
knw_build_record()
The database build a run reads, and the check that it is the evidence's
knw_db_latency() knw_db_latency_check()
The database's round trip, and the check that a database-bound run is on its host
knw_link_access_check()
How link's two access columns disagree, per species

Tuning

Build candidate rules around link’s thresholds and score them on held-out watershed groups, fit the joint use curve at the pick, and grade every segment by expected use. The building, scoring and fitting run in one call for every species and stage the evidence can speak to.

knw_tune_grid()
The candidate rules for one species and stage, around link's own thresholds
knw_walk_index()
Index the walks by source and river size, for the exception test
knw_rule_in()
Whether each visit is in under one rule, on the stream branch
knw_tune_score()
Score candidate rules on held-out watershed groups
knw_tune_repick()
Pick a rule again from a tuning table, at another width of the region
knw_tune_pick_report()
Set a tuning run's pick beside the published one
knw_tune_anchor()
How far each starting point moved the pick from the best-scoring rule
knw_tune_curve()
One curve per species and stage: use against size, gradient and distance to a river, together
knw_grade()
Grade segments by expected use, 0 to 1
knw_grade_species()
Grade every segment of a species' groups by its tuned curve
knw_tune_smoke()
Score a handful of rules and gate the scorer before a full tuning run
knw_tune_run()
Tune every species and stage the evidence can speak to, in one run
